weeks.label: Week of Dec 29, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we shipped a new Figma plugin and a comprehensive in-app notifications system, plus improvements to evaluation workflows and several UI polish updates to make interactions clearer and more reliable.

sections.title: Highlights
items: New Figma plugin: import designs more easily by selecting frames and exporting assets directly from Figma, with streamlined setup and login plus clearer in-plugin feedback for a more reliable integration experience.

In-app notifications: a notifications center with Personal and Team tabs, clearer icons, new notification types (team credits exhausted, study completed, study failed), and admin controls to filter audience—so teams and admins stay better informed.

UI and workflow polish: 'Star' has been renamed to 'Bookmark' across the app for clarity; filter/sort buttons and study menus now include icons and responsive labels; loading and button visuals were refined for a cleaner, more consistent interface.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 22, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates improve sharing and collaboration across studies and personas, streamline team navigation, and add clearer access control and company-claim workflows to make collaboration more reliable and discoverable.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Share studies, personas, and walkthroughs more easily: add share links with a simple toggle, streamlined visibility choices, and consistent sharing controls available from lists and detail views with helpful tooltips.
Faster team navigation and discovery: a new sidebar team switcher includes a 'Join Team' option, a prominent 'New' button, and redirects that return you to the studies list after switching teams.
Company claim workflow: users can submit and manage pending company claims through a clear dialog-driven flow, enabling teams to claim and activate company profiles.
Clearer access handling: improved access checks and a dedicated access-denied experience explain why a study is unavailable and guide users on next steps.

Sharing and accessibility fixes: copy-link controls now include proper labels for assistive technologies, and visibility/membership handling has been corrected so sharing and access behave consistently.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 15, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s work improves how design imports and media are handled, makes studies easier to use when empty, adds a heuristics library for managing checks, and polishes credit-related UI for clarity.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Design file imports now provide clearer guidance and warnings when imports are rate-limited, contain only non-frame content, or represent very long flows, so you know how to adjust files or retry.
Media improvements: you can now extract frames from uploaded videos to include in evaluations and walkthroughs, and the image-generation model has been updated for higher-quality visuals.
Studies page improvements: simplified wording throughout the studies pages and a new empty state that guides users when no studies exist yet.
New heuristics library: browse and manage heuristic checks from a dedicated library interface to make heuristic reviews easier to find and reuse.
UI clarity and labels: improved credits visibility in the navigation, shortened and clarified card titles in settings, and consolidated activity labeling for better readability.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 8, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates improve team onboarding and billing automation, make study management faster and more reliable, and introduce AI-generated weekly release summaries for easier visibility into changes.

sections.title: Highlights
items: AI-generated weekly release notes are now available in the app, providing concise summaries of recent changes to help you stay informed.

Simplified team invites and onboarding: invite people directly into specific teams, see suggested members during domain-based enrollment, support pending invites and automatic company enrollment, and manage member roles more easily.
Auto-refill for team credits: enable automatic credit top-ups (including zero amount), configure refill settings from billing, and enjoy clearer controls and confirmation flows.

Better study organization: star/bookmark studies across the app, sort and filter study lists by type and owner, and access starred items from study, persona, and evaluation views for faster access to important work.

Improved upload and form reliability: uploads are faster and more resilient with increased concurrent upload throughput, retry handling and offline detection; forms now surface connectivity warnings and long-flow alerts to reduce risk of lost work.
Clarified UI wording and behavior across the app (for example, using “screens” consistently), corrected violation count display, and improved tooltips and alert layouts for clearer guidance.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 1, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we shipped a major usability push: a redesigned public site with clearer conversion paths, improved study management tools, and a new design-workspace commenting integration that makes it easier to share findings.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Better Studies list — Find and manage studies faster with fuzzy search, sortable columns, persistent view and page-size preferences, mobile-friendly sidebar behavior, loading skeletons and helpful tooltips. Study rows now surface the owner and last updated person for clearer context.

Design-workspace integration — You can now connect your design workspace and post comments directly from study results via a new dialog and alerts. The integration is enabled by default and now shows clearer messages when external service limits affect posting.

Public site refresh — Redesigned homepage and pricing pages with a stronger hero, capabilities and data-safety sections, updated FAQ and pricing layout, client logos, and a prominent demo CTA to improve discovery and conversion.

Contact and demo flows — Added a contact page plus a fully functional demo request form with improved accessibility, styling, and reliable submission handling; form success messages and layout have been standardized for a smoother experience.

Improved communications and sign-in experience — Email templates include a clearer divider and formatted labels, success messaging is more consistent, and the external sign-in button and navigation have been polished for clarity.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 24, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on improving credit purchasing and management, making evaluation results more relevant, and clarifying UI behavior to prevent accidental actions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Streamlined credit purchasing and management — users can purchase credits via a simplified checkout flow, view recent purchases and a credit ledger, transfer credits between teams, see team credit balances, and benefit from automatic team selection and enforced purchase permissions where applicable.

Clearer in-app guidance when credits are low or unavailable — dismissible alerts and contextual messaging are now shown across relevant pages, with prompts to purchase or claim team billing where appropriate.

More useful evaluation results — cognitive walkthroughs and heuristic evaluations now produce fewer duplicate items, filter recommendations by goal relevance, and include context from adjacent screens so findings and recommendations are more actionable.
Safer persona and study management — the app now prevents deleting personas that are in use and provides clear, contextual tooltips explaining why delete/edit actions are disabled.

Reliability and usability fixes — heuristic violation indicators are visible on mobile, credit balances display as whole numbers, and several UI interactions have improved performance and more robust network error handling for a smoother experience.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 17, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on stronger team and access controls, clearer persona and study management, a new credits settings experience, and visual improvements across the app.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Easier company and team member management: admins can add, remove, activate/deactivate, and permanently erase members; personal teams are preserved when removing users; orphaned teams are identified; role and permission controls are clearer and update immediately in the UI.

Improved onboarding and team policies: companies can define default auto-join teams, users are auto-enrolled when appropriate, and there’s a toggle to disable personal teams for clearer team organization.

Better persona and study controls: persona creation permissions are enforced, company personas now appear in selectors for evaluations, team admins can manage team studies, and the app shows who last modified a study for better accountability.
New credits settings and clearer credit handling: a dedicated credits settings page with improved display and actions, plus updated behavior for initial credits during automatic enrollments.

Visual and media improvements: image galleries and evaluation layouts have been polished for better presentation, avatar contrast and fallbacks improved, and metadata image carousels aligned for a more consistent UI.
Ratings handling refined: rating is now optional when updating study content, and a duplicate-rating validation issue has been resolved to prevent blocked updates.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 10, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on smoother team membership workflows, easier team switching across the app, and clearer study listings and upload limits to improve discoverability and communication.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Improved team join request workflow: admins can include a rejection reason, requesters can add a note when applying, and both admins and requesters receive notifications and emails when requests are processed.
New Team Switcher and persistent selection: switch teams from the UI and keep the selected team reflected in the URL so your team context stays consistent across pages, including the studies view.
Better study visibility: pending PERSONA studies without records are now included in study listings so you can find and manage them more easily.
Clearer upload limits and study handling: upload limit naming and related behaviors were clarified to reduce confusion when submitting study data.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 3, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves team management and membership controls, adds severity ratings to help prioritize usability issues, and makes studies and evaluations more reliable with clearer failure feedback.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Easier team discovery and membership: browse teams with descriptions and member counts, request to join teams and see request status, and for admins, review and manage incoming join requests.
Configurable team join policies: teams can enforce different membership rules (open, invite-only, secret) so organizations can control how members join.

Severity ratings for usability issues: add, view, and update a severity level on issues and evaluation results (including a default “None” option) to help prioritize remediation directly from issue cards.

More reliable studies and clearer failure feedback: failed or re-run studies now replace prior results with fresh evaluations and present clearer messages when prototype file fetches or evaluations fail, making it easier to understand and recover from problems.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 27, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on persona versioning and improving usability across lists and AI-powered evaluations. Key updates make it easier to manage persona history, navigate large team/member lists, and rely on more consistent automated assessments.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Persona versioning: create and view multiple versions of a persona, see version details in persona profiles and study cards, and browse studies related to a specific persona version to preserve context and track changes over time.
Pagination for company teams and members: new page controls and clearer navigation icons make it simpler to browse and find teams and people in long lists.
Edit permissions for persona owners: corrected access logic so persona owners reliably have the ability to edit their personas.
More consistent AI evaluations: heuristic assessments are now more reliable and faster, reducing variability in automated feedback.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 20, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on expanding and improving persona profiles: you can now update personas with better validation and images, capture richer role and company details, add tools and expertise, and enjoy smarter form behavior.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Edit and save personas: update persona profiles directly, including uploading or replacing profile images, with validation to prevent incomplete or invalid submissions.
Tools and expertise: add a dedicated tools section to persona profiles and specify expertise levels for each tool, making personas more detailed and actionable.
Richer role and company details: capture employment status and refined job title information, plus Annual Recurring Revenue, so personas better reflect role context and account value.
Smarter decision-power handling: when a persona is marked as having no purchasing influence, the related budget fields are automatically cleared to avoid misleading information.
Improved persona images: updated image prompts to produce clearer, more relevant visuals for persona profiles.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 13, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we expanded the Heuristics library and management tools, simplified heuristic creation and organization, improved evaluation output and example handling, and made evaluation and persona generation more reliable.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Browse, create, and manage heuristic families and sets from the Library: clearer section titles and layout, a dedicated view for heuristic family details, and contextual controls so company admins can add custom heuristics.
Revamped Heuristic Set creation: a redesigned form with better validation, clearer labels and counts, the ability to add/cancel heuristic inputs, and drag-and-drop reordering for faster organization.

Richer evaluation results and example handling: evaluation output now includes a heuristic label, description, and example snippets; example violations show improved messaging and a fallback when no examples exist.
Better ownership and context: heuristics now surface their creator and include family details when viewed, making it easier to understand provenance and groupings.

Improved reliability: persona generation and the evaluation process handle failures more gracefully and respect organizational boundaries, and pages update appropriately after heuristic changes so the UI reflects edits immediately.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 6, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves how teams define and use heuristics for evaluations, enhances reliability when loading heuristic data, and adds team-focused management features including study transfer and team-based persona visuals.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Create and manage custom heuristics and organize them into families so teams can define, reuse, and standardize evaluation criteria.
Select heuristics or heuristic families directly in the evaluation form — selections update immediately and are applied to the evaluation for faster, more accurate scoring.
Heuristics now load and display more reliably during evaluations, reducing interruptions and improving result consistency.
Move studies between teams while preserving their associated files and access, making it easier to reorganize work and ownership across teams.
Persona images and team visuals are generated at the team level, and changing the selected team refreshes your dashboard and study lists immediately for up-to-date context.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 29, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on making AI-driven UI reviews more actionable and user-centered, plus a small visual polish for layout consistency.

sections.title: Highlights
items: AI-driven heuristic and cognitive evaluations now require explicit references to concrete UI/UX elements and provide clear, actionable recommendations, making review output easier to act on.
Evaluations are more focused on the intended user and their goals; when target-user details are missing, the system makes sensible assumptions so feedback stays relevant.
AI-generated reviews are more consistent and responsive, improving the reliability and timeliness of evaluation results.
Spacing for separators has been adjusted for improved visual layout consistency across the app.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 22, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates streamline evaluation workflows, improve team management and billing clarity, and make study data and assets easier to work with and discover.

sections.title: Highlights
items: CSV exports preserve original file names and use consistent formatting, making downloaded study data easier to identify and analyze.

Automated evaluations (heuristic and cognitive walkthroughs) are faster and more reliable: batching speeds up processing and background retries reduce intermittent failures so results complete sooner.

Evaluation forms and uploader UX improved: clearer instructions and stronger validation prevent incomplete submissions, while a redesigned asset carousel adds sorting and remove controls, better visuals, and higher image limits for easier upload and organization.

Team management and billing are clearer and more flexible: inline and settings-based team renaming, membership status tracking with deactivated members excluded from enrollments, consistent charging of the selected team, and visible team credits in the sidebar.
Persona pages now show a related-studies carousel and updated study cards, making it easier to discover and navigate studies connected to a persona.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 15, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves team management and member workflows across the app and introduces a more reliable email OTP sign-in experience with clearer resend and cooldown messaging.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Quickly switch teams from the top navigation using the new team selector, making it faster to move between teams you belong to.

Invite and onboard team members more easily: team admins can invite company members to teams, invitations send email notifications to new members, and invite flows provide clearer confirmation feedback.

Find and manage team members faster with a searchable member list, improved member detail views, and clearer empty states; teams pages now focus on teams you administer and hide personal team toggles for admins.
Added email OTP sign-in with improved resend handling and user-facing cooldown messages, clearer verification prompts, and increased reliability for sign-in links.
Miscellaneous UI and copy fixes: corrected messaging and punctuation, improved popover sizing and notification visibility, and clarified sign-in button text and input behavior.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 8, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on making company and team management easier and more transparent: streamlined team creation and member management, a clearer company/domain claim and approval flow, and smoother join/onboarding experiences.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Submit and track company/domain claims with an approval workflow and clear status updates — claims show pending/authorized states in the app and trigger clearer email notifications so ownership requests are transparent and easier to manage.

Faster team setup for company admins: create teams from the company settings, invite members during creation, and enjoy improved member selection. You can also toggle visibility of personal teams to keep team lists focused.

Easier member management and role visibility: search and sort the company members list, update member roles from the interface, and see membership roles in the sidebar and user menu. Access to company settings is now enforced by role so only authorized users can make changes.

Smoother joining and onboarding: clearer messaging and consent flows when joining a company, automatic association of personal teams to companies based on email domain, and recognition of first-time sign‑ins to improve the initial experience.

Improved communications and dialog polish: invite and claim emails use clearer language and action wording, and dialogs have adjusted spacing and messaging for a more polished, user-friendly experience.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 1, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we shipped organization and team management improvements, added PDF export for heuristic evaluations, and polished account navigation to make company and credit workflows clearer.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Organization settings and membership management: a new Org settings page lets admins update company name and logo, manage members and invitations, and create a company for your organization based on your email domain.

Team-level credits: teams now have credit balances with an initial allocation for personal teams, the ability to select and consume team credits when creating studies, and a visible credit history so teams can track changes.
PDF export for heuristic evaluations: you can now export heuristic evaluation reports to PDF with improved layout and print-specific tweaks for cleaner, more readable exports.

Improved account navigation and settings: the user menu now surfaces your organization context and clearer navigation to Account Settings, and the Account page shows updated user and company information with management controls.
Fixed company logo display so logos now render correctly across account and organization pages.

weeks.label: Week of Aug 25, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release strengthens team and ownership handling, expands persona capabilities, and delivers several UI and workflow improvements to make creating and running studies more reliable and pleasant.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Automatic personal teams and clearer team context: new accounts get a personal team and the app uses your selected team when creating studies, so ownership and team context are consistent and predictable.

Richer persona profiles: added job title and ethnicity fields, increased persona description length to 500 characters, and updated demographic icons — making personas more detailed and easier to identify. When a persona has a name, new studies will default to that persona’s name.

Safer and smarter forms: persona and location forms now prevent accidental submissions (for example, pressing Enter while place suggestions are visible), disable the submit button when no meaningful input is present, and respect users’ available credits during persona creation.
Smoother study workflows: the interface now refreshes automatically when a study completes so results appear immediately, and background status checks for studies have been made more reliable.

Visual and layout polish: improved button visibility and opacity, corrected avatar sizing and aspect ratio, refined loading skeletons, and other small UI tweaks for a cleaner, more consistent experience.

weeks.label: Week of Aug 18, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on building out persona capabilities and improving study workflows: you can now create richer personas, attach them to evaluations, select them more easily in forms, and enjoy several UI clarity fixes.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Create and view richer personas with profile photos, cover images, demographics, and descriptive details so personas better represent real users.
Associate personas with heuristic evaluations and cognitive walkthroughs and see linked persona details on evaluation and walkthrough pages, making studies more contextual and actionable.
Faster, more reliable persona selection inside heuristic and walkthrough forms — improved inline selection, keyboard/focus behavior, and input handling for smoother workflows.
General UI polish for clarity and consistency: improved list rendering, text wrapping, icon alignment, and cover/gradient spacing across persona and study pages for better readability.
Clarified evaluation inputs by normalizing heuristic labels and updating budget options so values are easier to understand and compare.

weeks.label: Week of Aug 11, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we added full persona support: you can create rich personas (including generated images) and run persona-based studies, plus several usability and reliability improvements to study controls and exports.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Create detailed personas with a dedicated form — add name, description, goals, locations, purchase triggers, and optional photos/cover images to model customer types more effectively.
Generate and attach persona images directly from the app — persona photos and cover images are created and processed automatically so you can include visuals when building personas.
Run persona-based studies — studies can now be associated with personas so you can design and execute experiments that use persona profiles as part of the study setup.

Improved persona form usability — the form is reorganized into accordion sections, with clearer labels and placeholders and better handling of uploaded files to avoid accidental overwrites when cancelling.
Study controls and exports improved — retry/polling behavior for study runs is clearer and more reliable, and CSV export now preserves step values for accurate reporting.

weeks.label: Week of Aug 4, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on improving account management and notification controls, streamlining study workflows and file attachments, and polishing the UI for performance and accessibility.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Manage your profile from a new Account page: update your name with validation, upload or remove profile images, and access profile actions directly from the sidebar.

Control notifications with a dedicated Communication Preferences panel—view, edit, save or cancel your settings. Sensible defaults are now available for existing and new accounts so preferences are consistent.
Improved study workflows: initializing and finalizing studies is more consistent across study types and now supports attaching and saving study files for reliable result capture.
Faster and more reliable loading of account and sidebar user information for a smoother signed-in experience.
Visual and accessibility improvements across the app: more consistent spacing and alignment, reduced layout shifts, improved button accessibility, and clearer hover interactions.

weeks.label: Week of Jul 28, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on improving evaluation workflows, reliability, and the user experience with clearer error pages, better diagnostics, and UI refinements.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Improved cognitive walkthrough and heuristic evaluation flows so users can submit evaluations more reliably; added sensible file upload limits and clearer feedback on evaluation pages.
Enhanced application logging and diagnostics, including background logging for sign-in and credit requests, to help detect and resolve user-facing issues faster and improve overall reliability.
Introduced friendlier error and 'not found' screens across both signed-in and public areas to provide clearer guidance and recovery options when something goes wrong.
Refined UI and interaction elements — updated styling and animations plus an improved More menu on study pages — making navigation and actions more intuitive and visually consistent.
Made study updates and results handling more reliable: saving study names and sorting heuristic results now behave consistently with improved error feedback.

weeks.label: Week of Jul 21, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on improving access control and reliability for studies, walkthroughs, and evaluation pages, plus standardizing production logging to speed up issue detection and resolution.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Added session validation across studies, walkthrough, and evaluation flows so only authenticated users can access those pages and are guided appropriately when not signed in.
Improved error handling and user-facing messages on studies, walkthrough, and evaluation pages so pages render more reliably and failures present clear, actionable information.
Standardized and expanded logging across frontend and backend services with consistent log formatting, helping the team detect and resolve issues faster.
Scoped remote/production logging to production environments only, reducing noisy telemetry during development while preserving monitoring for live systems.

weeks.label: Week of Jul 14, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves observability and refines the Walkthrough and Evaluation experiences: clearer, centralized logging and monitoring, richer form submissions with prototype import, better feedback for uploads, and added legal pages and navigation improvements.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Improved structured logging and monitoring across background processes and services, producing clearer, more consistent logs and health metrics to help surface and resolve issues faster.
Walkthrough and Evaluation forms now capture a target user and additional context with each submission, and submissions are associated with the submitting user for better traceability.
Added design-prototype URL import to the Evaluation form, plus a gallery view and collapsible sections to make walkthrough content easier to review and navigate.
Improved import and file handling with clearer, actionable error messages and stricter file validation so uploads and prototype imports provide immediate user feedback.
Added Terms and Privacy pages and improved site navigation and terminology for a more consistent, discoverable experience.

weeks.label: Week of Jul 7, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on making the Cognitive Walkthrough experience more complete and reliable, adding study re-run tracking and credit handling, improving sign-in reliability, and polishing UI layout for clearer results.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Complete Cognitive Walkthrough workflow: create, edit and delete issues and recommendations directly in the walkthrough UI; improved results display with filtering and clearer step navigation.
Study re-run tracking: studies now track attempt counts and re-runs correctly, with credits adjusted appropriately when a study is re-run.
Improved sign-in flow: resolved Google sign-in reliability and simplified sign-in error handling to reduce interruptions.
Cleaner, more readable UI: refined InfoCard, accordion, badges and spacing for better layout and easier scanning across walkthrough and heuristic views.
More relevant export options: export choices are now limited to study types where they apply, reducing confusion.

weeks.label: Week of Jun 9, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release introduces a dedicated pricing page with clearer plan comparisons and self-service credit requests, plus improved purchase communications and visual polish across the site.

sections.title: Highlights
items: New pricing page: view all plans and tiers in one place and request additional credits directly from the pricing page for a simpler purchase workflow.
Faster comparison: pricing details are presented in a clear table layout so you can scan and compare plans more quickly.
Clearer purchase communications: users now receive styled, branded confirmation and request messages that explain next steps and provide reassurance after a credit purchase request.
Improved visual consistency: updated header theming and unified spacing across pages for a cleaner, more readable interface.

weeks.label: Week of Jun 2, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates make it easier to review and share heuristic findings by enriching exports and improving on-screen clarity.

sections.title: Highlights
items: CSV and Excel exports now include heuristic ID, issue ID, recommendation ID, category, and label — making reports easier to cross-reference and import into other tools.
Heuristic list display updated so labels are clearer and badges are restyled — enabling faster scanning and better context when reviewing items.
Exported files now match the on-screen labels and categories, reducing manual reconciliation when sharing or analyzing results.

weeks.label: Week of May 26, 2025
weeks.summary: This week's release adds CSV and Excel exports, brings automatic study status updates to the UI, and improves heuristic organization and mobile interface behavior.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Download study data as CSV or Excel directly from the study menu for easier offline analysis and sharing.
Study status now updates automatically in the interface so you see progress and state changes without refreshing; update frequency has been adjusted to reduce distractions.
Heuristics can now include categories and labels, making it easier to organize and identify related items.
Improved heuristic UI and mobile behavior: cleaner header layout, better accordion responsiveness on small screens, and fixed an issue that affected the add issue button on mobile.

weeks.label: Week of May 19, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves sign-in flows and delivers major usability upgrades for heuristic evaluations, including the ability to add and edit issues and recommendations, more reliable saving and clearer presentation.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Improved sign-in experience: users can sign in with email or Google, receive clearer verification messages, and benefit from better email validation and confirmation feedback when requesting sign-in links.

Add and edit heuristic issues and recommendations in context: you can now create issues (including images and descriptions), add recommendations, and edit or cancel changes without leaving the evaluation view.

More reliable saving and display for heuristic evaluations: submissions and recommendation changes persist consistently, and results are presented in a predictable order by step and time to make reviews easier.

Cleaner, more readable interface and better mobile behavior: refined headings, adjusted typography, responsive dialogs and buttons, and layout tweaks improve clarity and usability across screen sizes.
Clearer inline feedback for updates: info cards and recommendation items now show more informative success and error messages and provide straightforward save/cancel controls for edits.

weeks.label: Week of May 12, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on improving the usability and reliability of heuristic evaluations and cognitive walkthroughs, plus more consistent in-app notifications to make reviewing, editing, and managing studies smoother.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Redesigned heuristic evaluation results to make reviews faster and clearer — results now use a cleaner card layout, show step numbers, handle images better, present violation counts more clearly, and provide collapsible sections and filtering so you can focus on the issues that matter.

Easier management for cognitive walkthroughs — you can now create, preview, update, and delete walkthrough studies more intuitively, with a visible preview badge and improved step navigation for reviewing study steps.
Consistent in-app notifications across public and authenticated pages — success and error messages are now surfaced reliably so you get clear feedback while working.
Improved reliability when saving cognitive walkthroughs so saves complete more consistently and provide clearer feedback on success or failure.

weeks.label: Week of May 5, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates focus on more reliable background evaluations and improved input handling so larger requests are accepted and automated results are more consistent.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Background evaluations are more reliable and consistent: processing now waits briefly before analyzing newly uploaded files and recovers from short interruptions, reducing missed or partial results.
You can submit larger structured and form-based requests (e.g., JSON and URL-encoded) without rejection, allowing longer inputs to be processed.
Overall resilience of automated processing improved, resulting in fewer interruptions and more consistent outcomes from background features.

weeks.label: Week of Apr 21, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s work improves how study files are handled and how evaluation findings are tied back to their source, making results easier to trace and more contextually accurate.

sections.title: Highlights
items: View files by study — you can now retrieve all files associated with a study in one place, simplifying review and management of study assets.
Results linked to source files — heuristic evaluation and cognitive walkthrough findings are now associated with the specific file they reference, improving traceability.
Context-aware evaluations — evaluation processes now use the actual file content when producing findings, increasing the relevance and accuracy of recommendations.
More consistent file processing and result tracking — improvements reduce mismatches between files and results, making study outputs more reliable.

weeks.label: Week of Apr 14, 2025
weeks.summary: Improved the guidance and wording used by our design review tools to produce clearer, more consistent, and more actionable usability and heuristic assessments.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Clearer cognitive walkthrough guidance that yields more detailed, step‑by‑step usability findings and actionable recommendations for addressing issues.
Expanded heuristic evaluation criteria to surface a broader set of design problems—including accessibility, consistency, error recovery, and user control—so reviews catch more relevant issues.
Standardized the structure and language across evaluation reports, making findings easier to scan, compare, and prioritize for follow‑up.

weeks.label: Week of Mar 17, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on maintenance to improve the app's visual consistency and reliability. No new user-facing features were released.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Global styles now apply consistently across pages, reducing visual inconsistencies.
Reduced brief flashes of unstyled content during navigation to improve perceived load quality.
General visual reliability improvements to ensure a steadier, more polished user interface.

weeks.label: Week of Feb 24, 2025
weeks.summary: Polishing and consistency updates across the app to deliver a smoother, more predictable experience for everyday tasks like signing in, navigating walkthroughs, and managing files and content.

sections.title: Highlights
items: More consistent and polished UI across core components (buttons, forms, dialogs, cards, breadcrumbs, carousel), resulting in a smoother and more predictable user experience.
Improved sign-in and account navigation flows for clearer and more reliable access to authenticated areas.
Enhanced walkthroughs and study pages with clearer layout and navigation, making it easier to create, view, and manage walkthroughs and studies.
Better file and media interactions — improved drag-and-drop file handling and gallery presentation for a more intuitive content workflow.

weeks.label: Week of Feb 17, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on making studies more reliable and easier to manage: clearer, more actionable evaluation results, dependable failure handling with credit refunds, and new controls to retry and monitor studies from the UI.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Retry and study controls: a new Study button lets you view and manage study status and retry failed studies directly from the interface.
Automatic credit refunds for failed studies: when a cognitive walkthrough or heuristic evaluation fails, credits are refunded and the study status is updated accordingly.
Richer heuristic evaluation results: evaluations now include violation status, clear reasons, and multiple recommendations to make findings more actionable.
More reliable evaluation processing: improved handling of evaluation results reduces incomplete or misinterpreted outcomes, improving overall study accuracy and status reporting.
Clearer cognitive walkthrough guidance: instructions were refined to better surface discoverability, learnability, and usability issues, producing more consistent and useful findings.

weeks.label: Week of Feb 3, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we launched and hardened guided study workflows—cognitive walkthroughs and heuristic evaluations—while improving file support, credit handling, and study status visibility.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Submit cognitive walkthroughs and heuristic evaluations and have results saved and viewable within your workspace.
Attach files (e.g., screenshots or supporting documents) to heuristic evaluations when submitting.
Automatic credit handling: credits are updated when studies run, and users receive automatic refunds if a study fails to process.
Clearer study progress: studies now include explicit statuses and automatically update to Completed when processing finishes.
Improved reliability and error handling for study processing, leading to more consistent results and clearer failure handling for users.

weeks.label: Week of Jan 27, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on more reliable, user-friendly study and evaluation workflows: evaluations are processed in the background, the heuristic evaluation form is improved, and study/user management is easier and more consistent across the app.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Heuristic evaluations now run in a background job queue so submissions are processed asynchronously, improving responsiveness and throughput for submitted evaluations.
Heuristic evaluation form now supports file uploads and includes input validation to reduce submission errors and guide users through required fields.
Users can view detailed study pages and delete studies directly from the app, simplifying study management.
User and study data now load consistently across pages, improving the reliability of profile, study, and interview views and keeping displayed information up to date.

weeks.label: Week of Jan 20, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves heuristic evaluations and refines visual presentation across the app, making submissions more reliable and content easier to view and act on.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Upgraded heuristic evaluation processing to a new v2 workflow, making evaluations more reliable and enabling richer inputs for more detailed results.
Fixed an issue with the evaluation form submission so heuristic evaluations now submit and process correctly.
Improved gallery image handling and styling so images display more consistently and provide a cleaner viewing experience.
Clarified recommendation presentation on heuristic pages so guidance is easier to read and act on.

weeks.label: Week of Jan 6, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on UI and navigation improvements: more responsive layouts, a clearer flow for creating and navigating studies, and improved walkthrough and empty-state clarity.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Improved responsive layouts across the app so study lists, cards, and headers adapt better to different screen sizes for a cleaner viewing experience on phones and desktops.
Added a dedicated New Study page and enhanced sidebar navigation so it’s easier to create a study and move between Studies and other areas of the app.
Updated cognitive walkthrough pages to surface results directly and present walkthrough details more clearly, making it easier to review outcomes.
Polished UI interactions and messaging: card hover behavior feels more responsive and the studies page now shows a clearer message when no studies are available.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 30, 2024
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on richer usability evaluations and easier access to study workflows. We added structured cognitive walkthroughs, a dedicated Studies page with improved navigation, and several UI refinements to make evaluations clearer and more reliable.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Run and review structured cognitive walkthroughs: create walkthroughs with step-by-step questions, expected responses, and issue tracking so teams can capture detailed usability observations and prioritize findings more effectively.
New Studies page and improved navigation: a dedicated Studies page plus updated sidebar dropdowns and breadcrumbs make it easier to find, open, and manage study-related workflows from a single place.
Clearer heuristic evaluations: evaluation pages now surface additional context and use an improved form layout to speed data entry and make results easier to interpret.
Fixed file attachment handling in the heuristic evaluation form so uploads now work reliably when adding supporting files.
Consistent media display: media and previews now maintain correct aspect ratios for clearer, more predictable viewing across devices.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 23, 2024
weeks.summary: Improvements to heuristic evaluations this week make creating, submitting, and reviewing evaluations clearer and more reliable: you can add contextual notes, see study names more prominently, and benefit from stronger validation and file handling.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Add an optional Context field to heuristic evaluations so users can provide additional notes when submitting reviews.
Display the provided Context with evaluations and enforce a 1,000-character limit to keep notes concise and readable.
Make study names more prominent in evaluation lists and detail views to help users quickly identify and find results.
Improve form validation and file handling for heuristic evaluations to reduce submission issues and present results more consistently.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 9, 2024
weeks.summary: This week’s updates improve the heuristic evaluation experience by allowing more detailed goals and removing UI constraints that made browsing and reading evaluations cumbersome.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The user goal field in heuristic evaluations now accepts longer input so you can capture more detailed, expressive goals.
Evaluation cards no longer show unnecessary scrollbars, making content easier to read and navigate.
Gallery items in heuristic evaluations now display at their full height instead of being clipped, so screenshots and notes are fully visible without extra work.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 25, 2024
weeks.summary: This week improves the heuristic evaluation experience with inline renaming, clearer violation messaging, and a cleaner file-and-form layout for smoother review workflows.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Rename studies inline — edit the title of a heuristic evaluation directly on the page to keep names up to date without extra steps.
Cleaner file and form experience — updated file card appearance and evaluation form layout for more intuitive drag-and-drop handling and easier review.
Clearer messages and reliable recommendations — violation counts now use correct singular/plural wording and recommendations are displayed consistently when available.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 18, 2024
weeks.summary: This week’s updates make heuristic evaluations easier to review and act on by adding visual context, clearer guidance, and improved handling of missing information and destructive actions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Browse visual context directly inside evaluations — images and screenshots are now accessible in a built-in gallery so reviewers can inspect examples without leaving the evaluation.
Values in evaluation items are now automatically recognized and presented in more meaningful ways, making it easier to read and interpret recommendations at a glance.
New 'User goal' and 'User flow' sections help reviewers capture context up front, improving consistency and focus when assessing issues and recommendations.
Evaluation instructions have been clarified and expanded to guide reviewers through the process more consistently.

Improved clarity for missing or destructive elements: the header now shows the study name (defaulting to “Untitled” when none is provided), empty recommendation rows show a clear empty state, and the delete action is visually emphasized to reduce accidental clicks.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 11, 2024
weeks.summary: This week’s updates strengthen heuristic evaluation workflows and improve UI clarity: evaluations gain broader coverage and clearer recommendations, navigation adjusts to session state, file metadata is more visible, and sign-in text is clearer.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Expanded heuristic evaluation coverage: the system recognizes more file and heuristic types and lets you view heuristics by type, improving evaluation accuracy and organization.
Added a Recommendations column to heuristic evaluation tables so you can see suggested actions alongside each evaluation.
Navigation now adapts to your sign-in status: the sidebar appears only when relevant, reducing clutter for visitors and surfacing tools for signed-in users.
File records now show type and size information, making it easier to identify and manage files at a glance.
Clarified wording on the sign-in button and privacy agreement to make account access and consent clearer for users.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 4, 2024
weeks.summary: Added a study name field and input checks to the heuristic evaluation form to make study setup clearer and reduce incomplete or invalid submissions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Users can now enter a study name directly in the heuristic evaluation form, making it easier to identify and manage studies.
Built-in input checks prevent blank or inappropriate study names, reducing incomplete submissions and the need for follow-up.
Improved form guidance and immediate feedback help users complete heuristic evaluations more quickly and accurately.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 28, 2024
weeks.summary: This week’s updates make heuristic evaluations easier to run and review: form inputs and uploads are more reliable, visual feedback is clearer, and navigation and study listings are simpler to use.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Simpler evaluation submissions — added a Study name field with validation and improved the upload UI and file handling so users can submit evaluations with the required information and smoother uploads.
Clearer progress and feedback — introduced a visible loading state and refined loading visuals so users know when an evaluation is running and when results are ready.
Easier-to-read results — violated heuristics now use clearer visual cues to help users quickly identify issues in evaluation reports.
Improved navigation and study management — added breadcrumbs across heuristic pages and updated the studies listing for simpler navigation and clearer study organization.
More reliable image uploads — image handling now preserves type information so previews and evaluations behave more consistently.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 21, 2024
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on a visual and interaction refresh: improved navigation, more consistent UI controls across the app, streamlined item management, and faster image loading for a smoother experience.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Redesigned sidebar and overall layout for clearer navigation — the sidebar trigger, spacing, and menu styling are improved so it’s easier to find and access sections.
Updated interface components across the app — buttons, cards, icons, and menus are more consistent, making the dashboard and evaluation pages cleaner and easier to use.
Direct item management from a new “More” menu — you can now delete evaluations from the item's menu, and the app waits for the action to complete before returning you to the list.
Faster image loading and priority rendering on key pages to improve perceived speed and make pages feel more responsive.
Improved forms and authentication controls — evaluation forms and sign-in/sign-out buttons have clearer layouts and behaviors for a more polished, consistent user experience.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 14, 2024
weeks.summary: Improves the loading experience by adding a dedicated loading pane above the sidebar to communicate app state and keep the interface stable. This change makes navigation feel smoother and reduces confusion while content loads.

sections.title: Highlights
items: A visible loading pane now appears above the sidebar to clearly indicate when content is being loaded.
The interface remains visually stable while pages load, preventing sudden layout shifts and reducing distraction.
Better feedback about loading state helps users know when interactions are available, reducing uncertainty during navigation.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 7, 2024
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on improving file upload and media handling, making the heuristic evaluation form more responsive and usable, and polishing UI visuals for a more reliable experience.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Drag-and-drop uploader and draggable file cards — users can now add files by dragging them in and manage uploaded files directly in the form with intuitive drag-and-drop interactions.
Responsive heuristic evaluation form layout — the form adapts to available space so fields and file lists rearrange smoothly across different screen sizes.
Improved media loading — uploaded images and files now load more reliably and efficiently from hosted storage, reducing display issues and improving page performance.
UI polish and icon fixes — SVG icon naming issues were resolved and sidebar controls were refined, improving visual consistency and button sizing.
More graceful handling of missing data — the app now copes better when expected data is absent, reducing blank states and interruptions during workflows.
